messages:
Tanya: Quick update — Northbridge Health signed a Private deployment with OpsLift as our MSP partner. 3-year commercial commit, Phase 1 is a VPC Private deployment focused on cardiac imaging pipelines. :tada:
Samir: Incredible — is this Dedicated or Private? Any marketplace listing?
Tanya: It's Private (VPC) with OpsLift handling managed services. Not a public marketplace listing; structured as a private-offer style commercial + MSP referral.
Michael: Who's on the handoff for onboarding + security checks?
Tanya: Elaine (SE) is owning onboarding. I'm pairing with Legal on DPA & IL6 checklist. @Elaine will post the onboarding runbook + compliance checklist tomorrow.
Elaine: On it. Initial tasks: access scoping, KMS key rotation, network peering rules, verifying syslog/SIEM forwarding. ETA EOD tomorrow for the draft runbook.
Samir: Nice — any asks for CS/marketing? Case study?
Tanya: Yes — asked the customer for a short case study and a 1-2 sentence quote once Phase 1 is live. Marketing, can you prep a one-pager and a 30s customer quote request template? :memo:
Mktg-Bot: @marketing team notified. I'll drop the one-pager template into #marketing in 15m and tag the comms lead.
Michael: Huge win for our Private pipeline. Shoutout to SEs, Partnerships, and Legal for the fast turn. :rocket: 
Tanya: Also coordinating a joint webinar possibility later in Q2 — will confirm once onboarding timeline locks.
Samir: Celebratory pizza for the ops team when we hit prod? :pizza:
Tanya: Yes please — pizza for the ops group. :raised_hands:
OpsBot: Deploy blocker check — no blockers reported. If infra needs a slot, ping @Elaine and schedule in the infra calendar.
Tanya: Thanks team — I'll circle back with links to the signed contract and the onboarding doc once uploaded. Great work everyone!
